description: Defines a template class ScopedTypeRef for managing ownership of reference-counted types, patterned after std::unique_ptr, with customizable traits for retain/release semantics.

classes.name: ScopedTypeRef
classes.description: A smart pointer class template for managing reference-counted types with custom retain/release semantics.

methods.name: ScopedTypeRef
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with optional ownership policy.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator to copy ownership from another ScopedTypeRef.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Releases current object and takes ownership of a new one.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the managed object without releasing it.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the managed objects of two ScopedTypeRef instances.

methods.name: InitializeInto
methods.description: Prepares the object for initialization with a create function, returning a pointer to the internal object.
